connector.name: Claude Code Bridge
connector.registryDescription: MCP relay so Claude Code agents on different machines can exchange messages via named channels.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package claude-code-bridge. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the constripacity account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_DB
env.description: SQLite database path (default: ./claude-bridge.db). Share the same path across HTTP and stdio instances to share state.

env.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Optional Bearer token. Only applies to HTTP mode (not stdio). When set, requires Authorization: Bearer <token> on all endpoints except /status.
